Name: SMTP too long line
description: Some antivirus scanners dies when they process an email with a too long string without line breaks.
Such a message was sent. If there is an antivirus on your MTA, it might have crashed. Please check its status right now, as it is not possible to do it remotely.

detection_method: Details: SMTP too long line OID:1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.11270 Version used: $Revision: 13470 $
solution: Contact the vendor of the antivirus scanner to get an update.

Name: Traceroute
description: A traceroute from the scanning server to the target system was conducted.
This traceroute is provided primarily for informational value only.
In the vast majority of cases, it does not represent a vulnerability.
However, if the displayed traceroute contains any private addresses that should not have been publicly visible, then you have an issue you need to correct.
